_doc: How the buildings are drawn (render/buildings/building_look.cpp): by style the instanced facade parts' sizes, the lot fence's bars and the roof plant; each finish seen from afar; the levels of detail. What the generator builds is data/catalog/buildings.json.

parts._doc: Sizes of the instanced facade part models (part_models.cpp): frame bar, door handle, brise fin (m). guard_h_m: the top of every guard (balcony, loggia and gourmet railings, roof terrace rails) above its floor, ABNT NBR 14718:2019 (guarda-corpos para edificacao: at least 1.10 m, raised from 1.00 m in the 2001 edition).

lot._doc: Lot fence and gate bar thickness (lot_emit.cpp), m.

roof._doc: Roof plant: square metres per air handler (roof_plant.cpp PLANT per_area).

shapes._doc: The sizes, shares and shades every building render file draws with, one block per file (render/buildings/look_shapes.h). Metres unless the name says otherwise: _share and _at shares, _shade a factor of a colour, a whole number a count. The values are the source game's models', as its files held them (B4 of log/review.md re-sources them).

facade_parts._doc: The pieces of an opening drawn in the facade (facade_parts.cpp), in metres off the wall's face (_out proud, _in in), _share and _at shares of the opening. Frames frame_d deep, frame_thin wide, frame_in in. Balconies: a slab bal_slab thick reaching bal_out, bal_edge in. Canopies over doors (canopy_*, their fascia fascia_*, brackets bracket_*) and double doors (dd_*); door leaves at most leaf_max wide leaf_gap apart, the fanlight and transom (fan_*, transom_*), the lamp over a door (lamp_*) and its wash on the wall (wash_*). Awnings (awning_*), loggia panes and glass rails, caps (cap_*), brise-soleil (brise_out), surrounds (surround_*), louvres (louvre_*), shutters' sills (shut_sill_*) and their colour's chroma and lightness (shutter_chroma, shutter_max). The gourmet balcony (g_*: slab, beam, rail, side wall, posts, its shade). A window's sill at least window_sill_min.

facade_emit._doc: A facade's wall drawn (facade_emit.cpp). A bay's face stands face_clear_in in and is tested out_test proud; pilasters pilaster_k of the pier, piers at most pier_max_share of a bay, from pier_from to pier_to of a storey; the ground storey lifts ground_lift. Bands: every storey's band_out proud and band_h high, the base's base_*, the slab's slab_* (slab_shade); the plinth plinth_out proud and buried plinth_bury. Entrance steps: risers at least step_min, a facade run at least facade_run_min, steps step_front deep with step_pad to the sides and step_foot at their foot, before a door door_w wide.

part_models._doc: The instanced facade parts' models (part_models.cpp), in shares of the part's box: a door's leaf (leaf_z, leaf_d), its panels (panel_*, panel_shade) and handle (handle_*, door_handle_w); a louvre louvre_t thick with slats slats filling slat_fill (slat_shade); an awning's canvas sloping canvas_slope with a valance valance_h high and valance_t thick.

placed._doc: A placed building's mouldings (placed.cpp): a moulding is mould_k of its wall's lightness; a band's lower tier reaches band_low of its projection to band_mid of its height, low_tier of its shade.

facade_bay._doc: A bay's opening and wall (facade_bay.cpp). The building's own window keeps min_sill_room under its storey's top, is at least min_w wide (w_margin from the bay's edges) and min_h high, head_room under the head; a bay narrower than no_opening has none. Thresholds stand threshold proud (threshold_below under the floor). Pane picks: of picks draws a bay's hash makes, dark_picks give a dark pane, roll_from to roll_to a rolled shutter, loggia_dark and brise_dark the dark ones of loggias and brises; a rolled shutter covers roll_base plus roll_step a step of the pane, standing roll_out proud; an opening taller than tall_opening is a door's. Rain streaks under sills: streak_out proud, under sills at least streak_min_sill high (french windows french_streak_sill), from streak_lo, streak_base plus streak_step a step long, streak_half plus streak_half_step wide, streak_top at the top, darkening to streak_dark (streak_mid between), on one bay in streak_skip, reaching streak_reach and streak_width of the hash. A wall run is wall_run_m (the macro tone's scale); a pane rises pane_on_wall_m off the wall behind it.

facade_props._doc: The props of balconies, loggias and windows (facade_props.cpp), in metres and shares of the opening: air conditioners ac_gap apart, ac_under_sill under the sill, ac_room and ac_edge of room; dishes dish_room, dish_off, dish_drop; pots pot_high, pot_min, pot_span, pot_tall, pot_tall_span with their soil soil_down and leaves leaf_wide, leaf_high and spans; props lift floor_lift (plants plant_lift) over the floor; corner_in and rail_in of the corners and the rail, mid and mid_drift the middle, quarter_back, half_deep; chairs turned chair_turn with their backs chair_back_deep; an airer from airer_min; tables table_deep, table_big, table_small, table_tall, table_side, table_chair, table_edge; a gourmet balcony's lounger from gourmet_lounger_narrow, bikes bike_off, a garden's end garden_end; ledges (ledge_in, ledge_deep, ledge_min), gourmet balconies (gourmet_in, gourmet_deep), insets (inset_in, inset_min, inset_corner, inset_plant, inset_chair, inset_turn); a garden of garden_few to garden_many things.

lot_emit._doc: A lot's ground and boundary drawn (lot_emit.cpp). A surface's cell on a slope ground_cell_m, a fold under level_m counts as level; the lot raised lot_raise. Walls: a foot foot deep, pieces piece long, a coping coping_h high standing coping_out proud (coping_shade), a splash band splash high (splash_shade). Fences and railings: rails rail_t thick (the low one at rail_low, low_rail_h high), posts post square each post_every reaching post_over over the top, light posts light_post each light_every, bars each bar_every; gates' posts gate_post and rails gate_rail. Lamps: a head lamp_head wide and lamp_head_h high on a post lamp_post; bollards' bands bollard_band_*. Planters' soil soil_in in; benches' seat and back (bench_*); a fascia fascia_h high (fascia_shade), awnings' shade awn_shade, a grille grille_t thick.

lot_props._doc: A lot's props drawn (lot_props.cpp). Bay lines line_lift over the ground covers (which lot_space.cpp lays up to 0.10 m); bumpers bumper_* (their shade spread shade_span). Flower beds' kerb and soil (bed_kerb_*, bed_soil_h: the source game's buildingMesh.ts emitFlowers). A pool's water water_lift over the covers and its coping coping_w wide reaching coping_over over the water. Loungers (lounger_*), a table's top and legs, a swing's posts, seat and ropes (swing_*, rope, rope_x), a shed's roof and eaves and an edicula from edicula_area (its door door_*), a clothes line's posts, wire and cloths, a pallet's planks, a gas cage's posts, rails and bars, its cylinders cylinder wide, cylinder_h high, each cylinder_every.

lot_parts._doc: Small lot parts drawn (lot_parts.cpp): a rock's shade rock_shade; a clock's dial dial_out proud with a margin dial_margin and hands hand_w wide (the long and short hands long_hand and short_hand of the dial); bay lines line_w wide, line_up over the ground.

roof_emit._doc: A roof's edges drawn (roof_emit.cpp): parapets parapet_t thick, copings standing coping_out proud, lips lip_h high (inner_shade, lip_shade); cornices cornice_drop under the eaves, cornice_out proud, cornice_h high; the Art Deco crown's two bands (deco_*, deco2_*); a slab crown slab_up over the eaves, slab_out proud, slab_h thick; rails rail_in in; machine rooms machine_in in and at least machine_min wide.

roof_plant._doc: A flat roof's plant (roof_plant.cpp). Placement: a coarse roof below coarse_min_h of storey, cells of cell, kept margin from the edges, rooms at least min_side; hatches with chance hatch_p; roofs over big_roof square metres more; age age_k, a tall mast mast_tall, solar panels older than solar_age, masts mast_age, a decay decay; round jitter round_jitter, a turn turn; solar variety solar_var over solar_base; lift rooms from lift_storeys, tanks from tank_storeys, masts from mast_storeys storeys; at most per_area_cap pieces an area, variants variants. Pieces: a drain drain wide at drain_at, drain_t thick; plinths plinth high; tanks tank_r wide with a rim rim_r dropping rim_drop and a lid lid_r rising lid_up (top_shade, lid_shade), tall tanks' rings tall_tank; casings casing_up, fans fan_r wide and fan_h high at fan_at, condensers cond_up, the fan plate fan_plate; solar panels panel_w wide each panel_step, rows panel_row apart, at most panel_max, from panel_z0 to panel_z1 high, panel_gap between; poles pole thick with bars bar and bar2 dropping bar_drop and bar2_drop; dishes on posts dish_post with plates dish_plate_*; vents vent_* , chimneys chim_*, doors door_*, lids lid and lid_t, ladders ladder wide reaching ladder_up.

roof_terrace._doc: A roof terrace's furniture (roof_terrace.cpp) on terraces at least terrace_min_width wide: a deck deck_in in over deck_share of it (deck_span, deck_t thick); pots (pot_*) each pot_every; tables (table_*) with parasols (parasol_*, on poles pole_half) and stools (stool_*); loungers (lounge_*); a pergola's posts, beams and slats (post_*, beam_*, slat_*, pergola_half); water tanks (tank_*, rim_*). The shares of terraces with pots, loungers, a pergola and tanks: pots, loungers, pergola, tanks.

roof_gear._doc: The gear set on roofs (roof_gear.cpp). Solar panels and skylights lift panel_lift with a top panel_top and rim panel_rim; vents vent_h, tanks tank_h and chimneys chimney_h high, capped cap_h high standing cap_out proud; gear sinks gear_sink_m into the roof. A spire on a foot spire_foot_h high sunk spire_foot_sink, spire_share of the roof's height, its flag at spire_flag_at, spire_flag_w by spire_flag_h. A lantern lantern_h high: its base base_h, its glass glass_h with bands band_t thick standing band_out proud (bands of them) and mullions mullion, a lid lid_h high standing lid_out proud, a dome dome_h high in dome_steps steps to a top dome_top, a mast from mast_foot to mast_top, a beacon beacon wide between beacon_low and beacon_high, its flag lantern_flag_drop under the top, lantern_flag_w wide in the aspect lantern_flag_aspect; round pieces have round sides.

roof_pitched._doc: A pitched roof (roof_pitched.cpp): eaves eaves out, the roof thick thick, the fascia fascia and the soffit soffit of the trim's shade, a ridge cap cap_w each side and cap_lift high (cap_shade of the roof), mullions mullion wide.

interior_emit._doc: A building cut open (interior_emit.cpp): flights drawn in flight_steps steps; the floor floor_lift over the storey's slab, so it never fights the slab's face; inner walls wall_half each side of their line (12 cm), the storey's height less wall_clear and at most wall_max high, a wall whose normal is within lower_dot of the camera's line comes down; a lift shaft's walls shaft_wall thick stopping shaft_clear under the next floor, its door at most lift_door_w wide and lift_door_share of the core, door_h high; the car in it cab_gap from the walls, cab_lift over the floor, cab_h high.

far_mass._doc: The far mass (far_mass.cpp): its plinth buried plinth_bury; its plain side stands mass_in_m behind the bays, past the deepest opening.

pane_rooms._doc: The rooms seen behind a pane (pane_rooms.cpp): a room is at most most_deep deep and most_wide wide each way, measured from inside the glass and off_glass behind it, at least least_deep deep and least_wide wide; the piece seen is the nearest within nearest_piece, weighed off_centre_k by how far it stands off the pane's middle.

building_bodies._doc: A building's body tone (building_bodies.cpp): each building's shade is shade_base plus a share of shade_span drawn from its id.

finish_far._doc: Each finish from afar, linear, in the order of its layers: the mean of its map (project/assets/surfaces/building-finishes.map.png, measured texel by texel in linear), times 0.91, the mean of the weathering the near level draws, for all but metal and glass. The far level multiplies a wall's tint by it.

lod._doc: hull_error_m: how far the simplified hull that throws the mid level's shadow may stray from its walls, under a shadow texel at that distance. level_fade_m: the band over which the near level and its parts dissolve into what follows; level_back_m: how far along the eye's ray the mid level stands behind the near one there, more than a window's recess. level_fade_s: how long a sub-chunk takes to dissolve from one level to the other once it crosses its switch in the band (the switch flips out a quarter of the band before the near end and in again three quarters before it, so an eye standing still never holds a half-dissolved level); a modelling choice: a dozen frames at 30 fps for the temporal filter to blend the screen-door, short enough to end before the range does. Shares of render.building_detail_end_m: parts (frames, railings, AC units) and the full near shell; the mid level (painted windows, real roofs) runs to building_mid_end_m, the far masses beyond. part_bands: instanced facade parts by bar width (second largest side), each drawn until it covers px_min pixels; far_hysteresis: a chunk leaves its superchunk's far mesh for its own detail below building_mid_end_m from its centre (with the eye height) and goes back beyond building_mid_end_m x (1 + it) (a band either side of the switch, so a chunk does not flicker between levels). far_rebuild_delay_s / far_rebuild_interval_s: a superchunk that already has its far mesh is rebuilt at least that long after a change and after its previous rebuild (a building appearing kilometres away is a few pixels).
